abstract: Serum levels of AFP, hCG and CEA were initially and serially measured in 59 patients with testicular germ cell tumors, and serially in 37 with ovarian and 3 with extragonadal germ cell tumors. Patients with seminoma/dysgerminoma or mature teratoma had normal serum AFP and sporadically slightly elevated hCG. Some patients with embryonal carcinoma, pure or with admixture of seminoma, had serum AFP elevated to maximum 100 U/ml, yet its use for monitoring therapy was limited. Patients with yolk sac tumors had elevated AFP and sometimes CEA levels, those with choriocarcinoma had elevated hCG, and those with compound tumors had one or more of the markers highly elevated. High AFP and/or hCG levels indicated the presence of the relevant tumor cells both in the primary and in residual tumor and/or metastases, also those missed in histological material, and thus were useful in restaging. Unfortunately, their absence in serum did not exclude the presence of marker-negative subpopulations of tumor cells. Changes in marker values paralleled the effects of treatment: the level increasing from any nadir heralded recurrence in patients in remission; elevated or increasing levels during therapy implied resistance to the therapy; decreasing levels indicated regression even though a return to the normal range did not mean eradication of all tumor cells.
abstract_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍59例では血清AFP、hCG、CEAを初回および経時的に測定した。卵巣胚細胞腫瘍37例と性腺外胚細胞腫瘍3例では経時的に測定した。セミノーマ/ディスジャーミノーマや成熟奇形腫の患者は、血清AFPが正常で、hCGが散発的にわずかに上昇していた。胎児性癌（純粋型またはセミノーマとの混合型）の一部の患者では、血清AFPが最大100 U/mlまで上昇したが、治療モニタリングへの有用性は限定的であった。卵黄嚢腫瘍の患者ではAFPおよび時にCEAが上昇し、絨毛癌の患者ではhCGが上昇し、混合性腫瘍の患者では複数のマーカーが著明に上昇していた。AFPやhCGの高値は、原発巣や残存腫瘍、転移巣における関連腫瘍細胞の存在を示し、組織学的検体では見逃された病変も含めて再病期分類に有用であった。一方で、血清中の値が陰性であっても、マーカー陰性の腫瘍細胞subpopulationの存在は除外できなかった。マーカー値の変化は治療効果と平行しており、寛解中の患者では最低値からの上昇が再発を示唆し、治療中の高値または上昇は治療抵抗性を意味した。値が減少すれば退縮を示すが、正常範囲への回復は腫瘍細胞の根絶を意味しなかった。
